Bodoland Stadium

Location
Baksa, Bodoland, Assam
Category
Sports / Community
Design role
Ola Magdy, Principal Associate Designer
Practice
Archohm

Overview

A sports-campus study exploring the architectural possibilities of woven form. Alternative schemes test the relationship between a football ground, additional courts, spectator facilities and the surrounding river landscape.

01

Two stadium studies

The design alternatives explore a rectilinear campus and an oval enclosure with a woven architectural expression.
